name: ctx.keybind
signature: ctx.keybind(key: keyof S & string, handler: () => void)
doc: Runs `handler` when the shortcut in the `keybind` setting `key` is pressed, anywhere in Discord. Reads the setting on every press, so a new shortcut applies at once. Removed on stop.
example:
// settings: { toggle: { type: "keybind", label: "Toggle", default: "Ctrl+Shift+KeyG" } }
ctx.keybind("toggle", () => ctx.toast("Toggled"));
